notes.title: Bulletmancer 1.3 - New Character!
notes.content:
A new Bulletmancer has joined us: Faericus, the Traveler! Unlock him by absorbing a total of 100 fairies and then beat a run with him to unlock a new spell.
Full changes:

[list]
[*] Added a new character: Faericus, the Traveler. His ability increases his stats permanently when absorbing fairies. Remember that increasing your Luck makes fairies appear more often!
[*] Added a new spell, Queen of the Fae. It makes fairies become Rainbow Fairies that grant all the buffs of the other fairies when absorbed.
[*] Fixed a bug where buttons in the main screen where still clickable after opening the option menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Bulletmancer 1.1 - VIsual Update
notes.content:
First content update for Bulletmancer is here! It includes a new feature many of you asked for that will provide more information about the build you are creating each run, along with some upgrades to the clarity and visual side of the game and an important bugfix related to the option menu.

Patch notes:
-Now you can see the upgrades you currently have while pausing the game and leveling up.
-Improved attack animations for many enemies.
-Stat scaling in upgrades is now marked with a specific color for each stat.
-"Vampirism" upgrade now includes a unique design for your cannon in line with the other Legendary upgrades.
-"Splash" upgrade now correctly says "deal 25% of your Attack" instead of 10%.
-Fixed a bug that caused the options you changed in the option menu to not be saved after closing the game.

notes.title: Bulletmancer - Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
There was an important error that made some runs impossible to beat, this patch fixes it. We want to thank the players that gave us feedback and we hope you continue helping us making the game more enjoyable. We also added to the patch a little improve to the clarity of Glyphs' description text.

-Fixed a bug causing runs to not end if the boss was killed with damage over time effects like Fireball.
-Clarified Glpyhs' description text explaining scaling.

notes.title: Demo is out!
notes.content:
The demo of our game Bulletmancer is out for you to play!

The game is still in an early stage of development so you can expect new content, bug fixes, QoL updates and general improvements to the experience while we are working on it.

[h3]Demo features:[/h3]
[list]
[*]3 Characters
[*]9 Enemies
[*]50+ Spells
[*]First map: Forestia
[*]First final boss: Four Guardians
[*]First two corruption levels to increase the challenge
[*]First four Glyphs to upgrade your characters
[/list]
If you enjoy the game you can support us by wishlisting it or spreading the word so more people can learn the way of Bulletmancy.
